text:
Kathy takes the Miami condominium by right of survivorship. Bill signed and delivered the deed while they were married, so it created a valid tenancy by the entirety, and the prenup waived only rights arising from the marriage, not property Bill gave her by deed. Tommy takes the Deerwoods pasture, and Julie's devise of the condo adeems because Bill no longer owned it at death. The remaining assets pass equally to Tommy and Julie, and Kathy gets nothing more from the estate because she waived her elective-share and pretermitted-spouse rights.

CONFIDENCE: 80
